description: Retrieve full scientific metadata for one or more samples by UID or SEEK ID. Returns metadata for the requested samples plus all parent and child (associated) samples in their full lineage. Output is JSON grouped by sample type; set output_format='excel' for an Excel workbook. Use this when the user provides explicit UIDs and wants comprehensive metadata including all associated samples.
llm_hint: Use when the user provides explicit UIDs and wants full sample metadata including all related parent/child samples. This is the correct endpoint for 'retrieve all samples associated with UID X' — not samples/{uid}/ GET. POST body must use field name "identifiers" (list of UID strings).
example_intents: Retrieve all metadata for SLD-230105ABC-12-PUB and its derived samples
Download an Excel spreadsheet with data for samples 12345 and 67890

description: List the registered SEEK user accounts. Returns each account's id and display name only, the whole list at once: no email, no projects, no filter.
llm_hint: Use only when the user wants the list of registered SEEK user accounts themselves. A person named in a sample question (a lab or PI, or the Scientist who made or handled samples) is sample metadata and is routed to graph_query, never to this endpoint. Not for the caller's own account or projects (system_question).
example_intents: List the registered user accounts in the system

description: Download one named SOP: fetch the SOP record by its SEEK id (sops/{id}/), which carries the file attached to it. It is not a search or a list: the whole-list call returns ids and titles only and cannot filter, page or count.
llm_hint: Use ONLY when the user names one SOP by its id and wants its file ("Download SOP 142"). Every other SOP or protocol question is graph_query: listing SOPs, searching them by word, lab or project data, counting them, which samples used a protocol (the protocol is on the DERIVED_FROM edge as `protocol_title`, and samples carry protocol attributes). SOPs registered to a project are reporter.
example_intents: Get the file attached to SOP 9001
